name: GoLogiq, Inc.
summary: GoLogiq, Inc. provides fintech and mobile solution for digital transformation and consumer data analytics. It offers CreateApp, a mobile app development and publishing platform for small-to-medium sized businesses; AtozGo, a hyper-local app-based delivery platform; AtozPay, an eWallet for mobile top-up, e-commerce purchases, bill payment and microfinance; and Radix, a big data analytics platform. GoLogiq, Inc. is based in Albuquerque, New Mexico.
